title: briza maxima f. rubra
intro: Briza maxima f. rubra, commonly known as Red Quaking Grass, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Briza maxima f. rubra include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its overall health benefits.
